title_en: Israel locks down occupied West Bank after Hebron shooting
excerpt_en: Israel has imposed a lockdown across the occupied West Bank after a shooting near Hebron killed two Israeli soldiers.

title_en: Jerusalem Daily: Israel to ‘lock down’ occupied West Bank
excerpt_en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu orders a “full lockdown” of the occupied West Bank following a shooting.

title_en: Israeli roadblocks disrupt schools and medical care in West Bank village
excerpt_en: Residents of Madama describe being cut off from hospitals, schools, and olive groves as Israeli forces blockade village.

title_en: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
excerpt_en: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

title_en: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
excerpt_en: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.

title_en: ‘Ominous start’ to West Bank olive harvest amid settler attacks
excerpt_en: The use of live ammunition, arson and the destruction of centuries-old olive trees have marked the opening weeks of this year’s harvest in the occupied West Bank.

title_en: ‘Season of fear’: Escalating Israeli attacks on West Bank olive farmers, deadly strikes on Gaza
excerpt_en: Israeli attacks on war-torn Gaza over the weekend killed at least six Palestinians, including children, despite a year-old ceasefire agreement. Meanwhile, in the occupied West Bank, settler violence continued through the ongoing olive harvest, with UN independent experts on Monday urging Israel to protect Palestinian farmers.

title_en: Gaza: Funding cuts leave half a million without food assistance
excerpt_en: Funding shortages have forced the World Food Programme (WFP) to slash assistance to hungry families in the Gaza Strip by roughly one third – a move that will affect some 500,000 people as winter approaches, the UN agency announced on Monday.

title_en: Israeli police arrest 10 over settler attacks on journalist and diplomats in West Bank
excerpt_en: It comes after masked settlers attacked Palestinians and European officials visiting the West Bank during olive harvesting season.

title_en: Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut aid to Gaza
excerpt_en: The number of people helped by the UN agency in the Palestinian territory will drop by about a third - from 1.6 million to 1.1 million.

title_en: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter
excerpt_en: Like many people in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, Ahmed Al-Omari is preparing for another winter of bitter cold and rain that threatens to cause flooding as families struggle to survive in tattered tents and damaged buildings.

title_en: Gaza: 340 children killed despite ceasefire agreement - UNICEF
excerpt_en: A little over one year since a ceasefire agreement was announced between Hamas fighters and Israel, more than 340 children have been reported killed and hundreds more injured, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.

title_en: Security Council LIVE: Deaths, demolitions spike in Gaza, West Bank
excerpt_en: Amid a rise in lethal Israeli strikes, demolitions and violence in Gaza and the West Bank, the Security Council held an open debate on Thursday focusing on the current situation in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

title_en: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean
excerpt_en: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for promoting, providing and protecting health in the Eastern Mediterranean region, home to some of the world’s top humanitarian crises such as Sudan, Yemen and the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

title_en: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza
excerpt_en: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.

title_en: 'Every day there is killing': Gazans face Israeli strikes despite ceasefire as peace deal stalls
excerpt_en: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

title_en: Israeli demolition in East Jerusalem displaces 69 Palestinians
excerpt_en: Sixty-nine Palestinians – more than half of them children – were displaced on Tuesday after Israeli authorities green lit the demolition of their residential building in the At Tur area of East Jerusalem, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has reported.

title_en: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks
excerpt_en: Three years after Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attacked Israel, UN Secretary-General António Guterres has said nothing can justify the atrocities of 7 October – calling for an end to the suffering of Israelis and Palestinians alike.
